Anthropic just released Claude Opus 5 today, and I switched to it immediately on Claude Code.
Press enter or click to view image in full size

Opus 5 comes close to the frontier intelligence of Claude Fable 5 at half the price.
On coding and knowledge work evaluations like Frontier-Bench and GDPval-AA, it is the new state-of-the-art, surpassing Fable 5 on those specific benchmarks while costing $5 per million input tokens and $25 per million output tokens, the same price as Opus 4.8.
If you are not a premium Medium member, read the full tutorial FREE here but consider joining Medium to support my work.
This is the fourth model Anthropic has released in less than two months, following Mythos 5, Fable 5, and Sonnet 5 in June.
The difference this time is that Opus 5 is designed for everyday use, not the most demanding frontier tasks.
